ios.desc:
Musa: Your Cycle Syncing Self-Care Dragon
Unlock your cyclical goddess era with Musa—where self-care meets science. More than a period tracker, Musa helps you turn your menstrual cycle into a source of power, not stress. Build habits that stick, boost your energy, and thrive all month long.
Why Choose Musa?

Way Beyond Tracking:
Musa doesn't just track your cycle—it transforms it. From mindfulness exercises to breathwork, every phase gets tailored self-care tools to help you feel amazing.
Daily Hormonscope:
Think of this as your daily vibe check—powered by your hormones. Know what's happening in your body and get science-backed tips to work with it, not against it.
Self-Care as a Game:
Make wellness fun! Complete mindfulness exercises, track progress, and celebrate wins with Mussy, your playful self-care dragon.
Actionable Cycle-Syncing Tips:
From food to fitness to mood, get easy tips for each phase of your cycle. Backed by science, made simple for you.
Personalized Goddess Avatar:
Design your AI goddess guide to unlock your power in every phase of your cycle. She's your empowering cheerleader every step of the way.
Privacy You Can Trust:
Musa is built by women for women. Our female CTO, who helped develop Airbnb's payment system, ensures your data is safe and secure.

Key Benefits:

Reduce stress and balance hormones with daily mindfulness practices.
Understand and optimize your energy, mood, and body throughout your cycle.
Gain confidence with personalized, actionable insights that fit your life.
Feel supported through every week of your pregnancy, emotionally and physically.

Who Is Musa For?
Musa is for women ready to unlock their hormonal power and take control of their health. Whether you're new to cycle syncing, already tracking your periods, or growing a little human, Musa helps you feel confident, empowered, and unstoppable.
Also in Musa: Pregnancy Mode
Because the journey doesn't stop here. If you're pregnant, Musa has you covered too.
• Week by Week:
Track your baby's growth and know exactly what's happening in your body every week of your pregnancy.
• Symptoms, Handled:
Get expert tips to reduce your pregnancy symptoms and stop feeling anxious — food, energy, sleep, and more.
• Meditations for You and Your Baby:
Pregnancy meditations to feel connected to your baby, every week.
• Emotionally and Physically:
Musa Pregnancy is different. We really take care of you both — your mood, your energy, your body.

Note: Musa is not a method of birth cont

quotes.text:
Musa — Mobile Engineer (iOS/Android) — Remote (Americas)

Musa is a mobile app helping women understand their hormonal health through a cycle tracker with personalization and a small companion character. Thousands use it daily.

We’re a small team, ship fast, and follow a Shape Up-style process. Low meetings, high ownership.

You will
- Own our iOS and Android apps

- Shape and build features end to end

- Ship often to a user base that shares the product organically

- Tackle challenges in personalization (AI), performance and UI delight

You

- Enjoy building and care about quality

- Like autonomy and product thinking

- Have strong Swift/Kotlin experience
